PLAN: wide — Levin, Julian, Max, and Kiaan — all four press their hands onto the egg at once, none letting go — the four strangers are bound to the egg together
rounds.rewriteBrief:
Levin — a school-age boy with blonde wavy hair, blue eyes, red fleece jacket, blue corduroys, brown boots — kneels in the foreground on bare earth at the base of a large mature linden tree, both palms flat against the left side of the smooth egg. Julian — a toddler with blonde curls, blue eyes, yellow body warmer, mid-blue joggers, grey sneakers — crouches beside Levin on his left, both hands pressed firmly onto Levin’s shoulders, face tilted down toward the egg, eyes fixed on it. Max — a school-age boy with curly light brown hair, green hoodie, grey tracksuit trousers, white sneakers — kneels to the right of the egg, both hands stacked over Levin’s right hand on the shell. Kiaan — a school-age boy with straight dark brown hair, orange sweater, brown corduroys, blue boots — kneels beside Max, both hands stacked over Max’s on the shell. All four faces are angled downward, eyes locked on the pale orange glowing egg resting in the shallow hollow at the tree’s base. Bright autumn afternoon sun illuminates the Lindenhof town square: historic buildings with cream facades and dark roofs frame the perimeter, outdoor chess tables sit under dappled shade, fallen leaves scatter sparsely on packed earth—not pavement—and no park bench appears. Wide shot, eye-level, full group visible in foreground with midground buildings and canopy above.

rounds.planLine: PLAN: medium — Levin, Kiaan, and Julian — the three press the bundled jacket between them on the dark stairs, Kiaan holding Julian's hand on the step — they are climbing at Julian's pace with only their bodies for warmth
rounds.rewriteBrief:
Levin — a preschooler with wavy, short, tousled brown hair and bright blue eyes, wearing a white long-sleeve shirt, dark blue corduroy trousers, and brown lace-up boots — stands on the lowest visible stone step of the narrow Altstadt lane, facing right, chest pressed forward to hold the tightly bundled red fleece jacket against his torso with both hands. Kiaan — a preschooler with straight black hair, round cheeks, and warm brown eyes, wearing an orange pullover sweater, dark brown corduroy trousers, and blue velcro-strap boots — stands beside Levin on the same step, facing right, left hand holding Julian’s right hand, right arm gently touching Levin’s upper arm. Julian — a toddler with soft blond curls, wide-set eyes, and a slight forward lean, wearing a yellow quilted body warmer, white long-sleeve shirt, mid-blue joggers, and grey velcro-strap sneakers — stands on the step just above them, facing right, right hand held by Kiaan, left foot lifted mid-step as he places it carefully on the next stair. All three boys press close together around the bundled jacket; their bodies form a compact cluster ascending the steep, uneven stone stairs under the warm glow of street lanterns. Autumn night: cool air, faint mist near ground level, scattered dry orange leaves on lower steps but none on the boys’ clothing or shoes. Medium shot, eye-level, framing from mid-thigh up, showing all three faces and upper bodies clearly, no egg or other objects present.

rounds.planLine: PLAN: medium — Julian alone — Julian pushes autumn leaves apart between two thick linden roots and reaches toward something round and glowing with warmth beneath them — the warm egg exists and has been found
rounds.rewriteBrief:
Julian — a toddler with ear-length curly light blonde hair and blue eyes, wearing his bright yellow quilted anorak, grey fleece-lined pull-on trousers, and dark blue rubber boots — kneels in the center foreground between two thick, sprawling linden roots on the Lindenhof plaza, his left hand pushing aside deep red and yellow autumn leaves, his right hand extended forward toward the football-sized dragon egg. The egg — smooth, faintly scaly, leathery shell glowing with vibrant warm reddish-orange light — sits nestled directly beneath the roots, illuminating the dry leaves and brown earth around it. No other people or animals are present. Medium shot, clear foreground focus, cold afternoon light, grey stone and brown earth visible under shallow leaf cover, no chess board, no benches, no background figures.

rounds.rewriteBrief:
Levin — a school-age boy with short dark hair and serious brown eyes, wearing a forest-green zip-up fleece jacket with patch pockets, dark blue corduroy trousers, and brown lace-up ankle boots — walks forward on the gravel of the Lindenhof plaza, back view, shoulders slumped, head lowered, right heel lifting off the gravel, brow drawn, mouth tight. Max — a school-age boy with messy light-brown hair and determined blue eyes, wearing an orange crew-neck wool pullover, dark brown corduroy dungarees with bib and suspenders, grey socks, and black rubber ankle boots — stands on the left, back view, right foot stamping hard into the gravel, jaw set, weight fully on his left foot, right boot descending. Julian — a school-age boy with straight sandy hair and wide attentive eyes, wearing a bright yellow quilted anorak, grey pull-on trousers, and blue rubber Wellington boots — stands on the right, back view, head bowed, mouth a small worried line, both feet planted, weight evenly distributed. All three face the Lindenhofbrunnen [LOC002.3] in the deep background, its grey stone steps losing the last warm sunlight as long cold shadows stretch across red and yellow autumn leaves scattered on the gravel. Wide shot, low angle, foreground gravel sharply in focus, fountain midground, historic buildings including Grossmünster [LOC003.2] visible in background.

rounds.rewriteBrief:
Levin — a preschooler with wavy light blonde hair, bright blue eyes, and a small frame, wearing a green fleece jacket, dark blue trousers, and brown boots — sits cross-legged in the center foreground of the wide Lindenhof plaza, facing the camera, his jacket fully open and arms wrapped tightly around Lindi, who rests upright against his chest with her warm orange-red scales visible, her golden eyes open and calm. Max — a school-age boy with light brown curly hair, wearing an orange pullover, dark brown corduroy dungarees, grey wool socks pulled up over black rubber boots — sits directly left of Levin, back view, shoulders and head angled inward toward Levin and Lindi, his hands resting on his thighs. Kiaan — a school-age boy with dark brown straight short hair and bangs, wearing a deep purple hooded sweatshirt, olive trousers, and white trainers — sits directly right of Levin, back view, shoulders and head angled inward toward Levin and Lindi, hands resting on his thighs. Julian — a school-age boy with light blonde curly ear-length hair, wearing a yellow anorak, grey fleece-lined pull-on trousers, and dark blue rubber Wellington boots — sits directly behind Levin, back view, his broad back forming a solid vertical block, head tilted slightly forward toward Lindi, hands resting on Levin’s shoulders. Nia — a large Bernese Mountain Dog with a tricolor coat (black body, bright white chest and muzzle, rust patches above eyes and on legs), thick fluffy fur, large friendly brown eyes, soft ears lying flat, thick tail, and a plain red leather collar — sits upright in the left foreground, facing right toward Levin and Lindi, front paws planted firmly on the cobblestones. The plaza is bare and windswept under a dark autumn night sky; distant historic buildings including Grossmünster towers are visible in the background. Wide shot, low angle, shallow depth of field emphasizing the tight huddle.
